text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure we'll be able to see
shooting stars?
The sky's so cloudy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've come out to help with a meteor
shower
viewing event for children.
choice_data_list: Wait just a little longer, okay!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's only an hour to sunset, but the
weather report
doesn't look promising.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Still, you never know! Things might clear
up
suddenly! We just have to trust the
skies and be
patient!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I hope it'll clear as well, but if we're
going to cancel the event, it'd be wise to
do so sooner than later. As our
supervisor, what do you think we should
do?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Well, in that case, let's make our own
shooting
stars!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat the details! ☆ For now, we
need to
go to Tracen! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your patience, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Feast your eyes on this marvelous meteor shower that's exclusive to Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Here we go! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Twinkle! Glitter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Marvelous Sunday sprints about with
light sticks, their afterimage creates a
smattering of sparkling lights under the
cloudy skies... They're a
far cry from real shooting stars though.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Hahaha! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she continues to run around,
and the glow from the light sticks seems
to last longer and
longer as she speeds
up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoooosh!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
This marvelous show's just getting
started!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
What? When did the clouds scatter?
How can this
be?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Dazzling and beautiful! It's
maaarvelous! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The clouds dissipate and the beautiful
night sky unrolls above us. It's almost as
if there were never
any clouds in the first
place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sparkle! ☆

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look! It's a shooting star! Did you
see that
flash?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
But the bizarre trajectory is nothing like
a
shooting star's!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Ooh, it's flying around! That's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Are we experiencing a mass
hallucination? That
light can't be
natural!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Okay, time for the grand finale!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
These stars have been simply
marvelous! ☆ Thank
you for the dazzling
memories!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Glitter! Gleam!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When the moment passes, the shooting
stars and mysterious lights vanish, and
the night sky looks
perfectly
unremarkable once again.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! ☆ That was so beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It was indeed, though I'm more curious
about
what that flying light was exactly.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
What do you make of that phenomenon
we saw?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's logical, but it doesn't explain
everything.
I'd like to conduct a proper
study...
choice_data_list: I want to see it with my own eyes ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the strange experience,

Marvelous Sunday and Ikuno Dictus
come to chat
with me.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Look at this! The kids from the other day
drew
some pictures of the meteor
shower!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their illustrations are of countless
shooting stars
streaking across the sky...
and one particularly
bright light.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It appears we all witnessed the same 
phenomenon. What happened that night
can't be
explained away as a mere
dream.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Of course not! It was a marvelous
night! ☆
Marvelous beyond explanation,
in fact! ★

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... For some reason, it's quite
convincing
when you put it that way.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Let's see if Marvelous can
recreate the
phenomenon.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ooh, then let's try it together this time!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaarvelous! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though we all wave our light sticks
around wildly, there's no sign of the
mysterious light.
Perhaps whatever made
it has gone already.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It could be that certain criteria must be
met in
order to trigger that light, such as
time of day and coordination of our
sticks.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: But we're all as pretty as real stars now!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We are! ☆ And I'm sure the
marvelousness you're
all spreading will
reach that light! ★ I'm
positive! ☆
